newsitem.title: HONG KONG: San Mig HK parent poses privatisation plan.
newsitem.headline: San Mig HK parent poses privatisation plan.

text.p: San Miguel Brewery Hong Kong Ltd said in an announcement published on Wednesday it has been approached by its controlling shareholder regarding the privatisation of the Hong Kong company.
Neptunia, which holds 64 percent of the Hong Kong-listed company, envisages a privatisation price of about HK$3.75 for each ordinary share, the announcement said.
Neptunia is a wholly-owned subsidiary of food and drink giant San Miguel Corp of the Philippines.
The announcement said that if an offer is made by Neptunia, an independent board committee and financial advisers will be appointed to consider the terms and proposals of any offer.
Trading in the shares of San Miguel Hong Kong, which was suspended at the company's request on Tuesday, will resume on Wednesday, October 30, the announcement said.
The share closed at HK$3.675 on Monday.
